# FileZenith (filezenith.com)

> FileZenith is an all-in-one private online file studio providing 80+ document, PDF, image, and utility tools. All file processing runs 100% client-side inside the user's browser memory using WebAssembly (Wasm) and HTML5 Canvas. Zero bytes of user documents or images are ever uploaded to cloud servers.

## Key Technical Specifications & Architectural Guarantees
- **Zero-Server Processing:** Files never leave the client device; all transformations occur in local browser memory.
- **Privacy Standard:** Immune to server-side data leaks, cloud storage breaches, or automated scraping.
- **Cost & Limits:** 100% free forever, no account registration required, no watermarks, no artificial daily file limits.
- **Cross-Platform:** Works on all modern web browsers across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux. Supports offline execution via Progressive Web App (PWA) architecture.
- **Publisher:** Engineered by Aaradhya Pathak at Snab Studio (Nashik, Maharashtra, India).
- **Official Website:** https://www.filezenith.com

---

## 1. Core PDF Studio Tools
- **[Edit PDF Online](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/edit):** Add custom text, signatures, highlights, and annotations directly inside browser memory.
- **[Compress PDF (Auto)](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/compress):** Shrink document file sizes up to 80% without degrading visual text readability.
- **[Compress PDF to 200KB](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/compress-to-200kb):** Pre-calibrated binary compression to fit government recruitment portals, college admissions, and scholarship uploads.
- **[Compress PDF to 100KB](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/compress-to-100kb):** Extreme high-efficiency compression targeting sub-100KB limits.
- **[Compress PDF to 1MB](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/compress-to-1mb):** Downscale multi-page legal documents and portfolios under 1MB for email attachments.
- **[Merge PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/merge):** Combine multiple PDF documents into a single consolidated file in custom order.
- **[Split PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/split):** Extract individual pages, custom page ranges, or split documents into separate files.
- **[Combine Marksheets](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/combine-marksheets):** Merge 10th and 12th grade marksheets into a single A4 PDF under 500KB.
- **[Mask Aadhaar Card](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/mask-aadhaar):** Redact and mask the first 8 digits of Aadhaar cards (XXXX-XXXX-1234) offline for compliant KYC.
- **[Redact PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/redact):** Permanent pixel-level blackout redacting sensitive data with complete layer flattening.
- **[Organize & Rotate PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/organize):** Reorder, rotate 90/180/270 degrees, and delete unnecessary pages.
- **[Password Protect PDF](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/protect):** Encrypt documents with standard AES-128 / AES-256 password protection.
- **[Unlock / Remove Password](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/remove-password):** Decrypt user-owned PDFs and remove restriction locks.
- **[PDF OCR Text Extractor](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/ocr):** Client-side optical character recognition using Tesseract.js WebAssembly.
- **[PDF to Word (DOCX)](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/pdf-to-word):** Convert PDF pages into editable Microsoft Word documents.
- **[Word to PDF Converter](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/word-to-pdf):** Convert .docx files into crisp, standardized PDF documents.
- **[Pics to PDF (JPG to PDF)](https://www.filezenith.com/image/pics-to-pdf):** Convert batches of camera photos, scans, JPGs, and PNGs into clean single or multi-page PDFs.
- **[PDF to JPG / PNG](https://www.filezenith.com/pdf/to-image):** Render high-resolution raster images from PDF pages.

## 2. Core Image Studio Tools
- **[Passport & Visa Photo Maker](https://www.filezenith.com/image/passport-maker):** Prepare official 2x2 inch (US DS-160), 3.5x4.5 cm (India / Schengen), and 213x213 px (PAN Card) photos with head oval guides.
- **[Signature Resizer 10 to 20KB](https://www.filezenith.com/tools/signature-resizer-10-to-20kb):** Clean up paper shadows and lock signature byte counts between 10KB and 20KB for govt applications.
- **[Compress Image to 20KB](https://www.filezenith.com/image/compress-to-20kb):** High-precision binary search compression for strict portal upload caps.
- **[Compress Image to 50KB](https://www.filezenith.com/image/compress-to-50kb):** Optimize applicant photos to meet 20KB–50KB portal requirements.
- **[Compress Image to 100KB](https://www.filezenith.com/image/compress-to-100kb):** Compress identity documents and driving licenses below 100KB.
- **[Convert HEIC to JPG](https://www.filezenith.com/image/convert-heic):** Batch convert Apple iPhone HEIC images to universal JPG format in-browser.
- **[Convert WebP to JPG](https://www.filezenith.com/image/webp-to-jpg):** Convert modern WebP web assets to standard JPEG format.
- **[Remove Background (AI)](https://www.filezenith.com/image/remove-background):** Local neural network background removal running in-browser with zero upload.
- **[Photo Name & Date Stamp Generator](https://www.filezenith.com/tools/photo-name-date-generator):** Stamp candidate name and Date of Photograph (DOP) on passport portraits.

- **[Home & Car Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.filezenith.com/utility/emi-calculator):** Monthly EMI breakdown with amortization schedules.
- **[SIP Return Calculator](https://www.filezenith.com/utility/sip-calculator):** Mutual fund systematic investment wealth forecasting.

- **[CGPA to Percentage Converter](https://www.filezenith.com/utility/cgpa-to-percentage):** Verified conversion formulas for CBSE, Mumbai University, VTU, and AICTE.
- **[Age Calculator & Birthday Countdown](https://www.filezenith.com/utility/age-calculator):** Exact age calculation in years, months, days, and seconds.
- **[WhatsApp Direct Chat Link](https://www.filezenith.com/social/whatsapp-direct-chat):** Start WhatsApp conversations without saving phone numbers to address book.
- **[QR Code Generator](https://www.filezenith.com/utility/qr-generator):** Create custom high-resolution vector QR codes with colors and logos.
